# pgextwin CLI v0.3.0 — authenticated Catalog latest by default

Windows x64 self-contained single-file `pgextwin.exe`, read-only original ZIP downloader.

## One-line latest registered packages

```powershell
.\pgextwin.exe download-all --pg all
```

The standard command selects the *current Catalog-registered official Release* for each of the 14 pgextwin extensions, for PG14/15/16/17/18. It does **not** guess from upstream tags, draft Releases or GitHub's separate `releases/latest`. To retrieve one major, use `--pg 18`. For explicit legacy v0.2.2 fixed 2026-10-17 inventory:

```powershell
.\pgextwin.exe download-all --pg all --fixed
```

An explicit `--latest` flag is accepted but not required.

The CLI retrieves the canonical public Catalog feed and its Sigstore bundle via stable GitHub Release browser/download URLs without GitHub REST API calls. It independently verifies the OIDC identity for `pgextwin/catalog/.github/workflows/cli-signed-catalog-feed.yml@refs/heads/main`, Sigstore transparency log, verified timestamps, the Catalog source commit and all 15 immutable record bytes against signed SHA256. The feed producer separately checks protected main/required Validate and original public Release/asset IDs and hashes. Original ZIPs use the previously validated bounded GitHub HTTPS browser transport, streamed SHA256, 64 MiB per ZIP, exact ZIP magic and all-or-nothing output staging. The `DOWNLOAD-INFO.json` receipt includes Release tag and Catalog commit for each original ZIP. `INTEGRITY_ONLY` is not original extension Sigstore signature verification; `signatureVerified=false`, `provenanceVerified=false`, `publicationAuthorized=false`, `distributionAuthorized=false`, `installAuthorized=false` remain explicit.

Missing/invalid Sigstore trust root, signature mismatch, source commit mismatch, Catalog drift, wrong tags, asset digest mismatch, unsafe redirects, non-200 public HTTP responses and local directory collision fail closed; there is **no silent fallback** to frozen versions. The read-only signed-commit determination is independently verified GitHub Actions Sigstore identity and original feed bytes, not independently verified original extension signatures.

## Acceptance evidence

- Protected Catalog PR #123 and genuine Windows authenticated selected-Catalog real 70 ZIP SHA256: https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39236569189
- Postmerge selected-Catalog 70 real ZIP Windows SHA256: https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39236902866
- PR #124 clean Windows **anonymous**, no GitHub token, real public 70 ZIP SHA256 70/70: https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39237271741

The new v0.3.0 **public EXE** requires separate current-source R6 Sigstore attest, independent original-byte SHA256, owner-approved create-only CLI R7 intent, complete CI, and then actual public EXE re-download and one-line 70 ZIP verification. The historic extension P1 gaps and #75 GO B/G4/G5 are not claimed as fixed by a CLI binary release.

## Independently verify the public v0.3.0 EXE

Original Windows x64 single-file EXE SHA256:
`5fac25624f4c3ffa84147280308eb85f0627ed9993e3f280566c82f177a72318`

Protected-main source: `04c06ee206d790cd0704bc16b0781f0061fb6238`

Successful original signed R6 candidate/independent Windows verifier:
https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39243788109

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\pgextwin.exe -Algorithm SHA256
gh attestation verify .\pgextwin.exe --repo pgextwin/catalog --signer-workflow pgextwin/catalog/.github/workflows/cli-candidate.yml --source-ref refs/heads/main --source-digest 04c06ee206d790cd0704bc16b0781f0061fb6238
```

Compare original EXE digest against both the displayed expected value and
the public SHA256SUMS.txt asset. The CLI binary's genuine SLSA provenance is
verified separately from the Catalog feed's Sigstore authentication. Neither
establishes original extension ZIP Sigstore authenticity.

The signed Catalog selection feed is published as a separate, stable **metadata-only**
Release. CLI v0.3.0 remains a `--prerelease --latest=false` publication to avoid
changing that feed's `releases/latest/download` endpoint.

No Windows Authenticode signature, ZIP extraction, installation, service mutation,
new extension Publisher authorization, offline signed bundle, or formal original
extension SLSA/SPDX acceptance.

## 日本語

### このバージョンの主な機能

Windows x64用の自己完結型・単一EXEです。標準コマンド ` .\pgextwin.exe download-all --pg all `（空白は適宜除去）で、Catalog登録済みの14拡張×PG14～18、合計70件の元ZIPを取得します。`--pg 18`なら14件、`--fixed`ならv0.2.2由来の2026年10月17日固定版を取得します。`--latest`は省略可能です。

**参考：** v0.3.0時点の機能と証跡を記述しています。後続バージョンの機能を過去のEXEに遡及適用したものではありません。

# pgextwin CLI v0.2.2 — Windows x64, one-line 70 ZIP download

**PowerShell (no other arguments):**
```powershell
.\pgextwin.exe download-all --pg all
```

This creates `pgextwin-pg14-18` in the current directory and retrieves 70 *original separate extension ZIP files* (14 for each of PostgreSQL 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18). To download just one major, use `--pg 18`.

## v0.2.2 real transport recovery

The original v0.2.1 command was independently tested on Windows, and **failed closed**: GitHub's anonymous REST Release API returned HTTP 403; see [failed, never waived real 70 ZIP Run 39211137784](https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39211137784). This release fixes that actual failure rather than asking users for a GitHub token or manually supplied pin paths.

The signed CLI retains a fixed historical P1 candidate policy independently baked SHA256 `dc1e52bbb10f52d0c1f14913e99bf30e6dc4855e0c39d0547b78f39da549f201`, at policy source SHA `4dcf3b9c601c6fd43a7ee34bb0f73592f5509a34` and Catalog original `e372e2c6a95adcf8227ea82d6253df3792b6f029`. These 16 raw original files are fetched at immutable GitHub HTTPS paths and exact hash checked before any ZIP GET. For the one-line mode, ZIP bytes come through *exact pinned public GitHub Release browser URLs*, not anonymous GitHub REST API endpoints, with strict HTTPS/CDN redirect allowlist, max 64 MiB per ZIP, original ZIP SHA256/ZIP magic verification and atomic rollback. This avoids anonymous GitHub REST quota by design. Existing explicit advanced `download` / `download-all --catalog-dir --policy --policy-sha256 --output` modes still perform live API numeric Release ID checks.

Original numeric repository/release/asset IDs in the auto mode are independently **policy pinned**, but **not live REST queried**; `DOWNLOAD-INFO.json` records `releaseMetadataVerified=false`. Download success means only `INTEGRITY_ONLY`, not formal P1 acceptance of all 70 originally signed extension releases or Sigstore authenticity. Never treat a stale, changed, missing or mismatched original asset as PASS. The snapshot is frozen and does not auto-select newer releases.

No installation, service change, ZIP extraction, automatic privilege elevation, signed enclosing archive, extension release publication or original extension SLSA/SPDX verification. #75 GO B/G4/G5 safety gates remain unchanged.

## Verify the CLI executable

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\pgextwin.exe -Algorithm SHA256
gh attestation verify .\pgextwin.exe --repo pgextwin/catalog --signer-workflow pgextwin/catalog/.github/workflows/cli-candidate.yml --source-ref refs/heads/main --source-digest 594df3d703d983d5978b640a03c64d498765035a
```

Expected SHA256: `3567e34cf9f7347cfab7a1292f58965b7bd15e2d8a2bb5b1f0479685633862a0`.

Protected original R6 signer+Windows verifier [Run 39211701760](https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39211701760). Includes SPDX2.3, original SHA256SUMS and Microsoft .NET runtime notices (self-contained runtime 10.0.13). No Windows Authenticode signature.

# pgextwin CLI v0.2.0 — Windows x64

A self-contained Windows x64 command-line tool to browse the 14 pgextwin PostgreSQL extensions and download individually published original ZIPs in bulk.

## New in v0.2.0

**`download-all`** downloads the 14 original ZIP files of any one PostgreSQL major, or up to **70 original ZIP files for PG14–18**. Files are grouped under `pg14/` ... `pg18/`, with `DOWNLOAD-INFO.json` recording exact source ZIP bytes, SHA256, and numerical GitHub Release IDs. An entire batch is staged privately and renamed to its final new directory only after every selected ZIP passes identity and checksum validation. No partial completed batch is exposed and existing output cannot be overwritten.

```powershell
.\pgextwin.exe --version
.\pgextwin.exe list --catalog-dir C:\approved\catalog --pg 18 --format json
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\pgextwin-downloads
.\pgextwin.exe download-all --pg 18 --catalog-dir C:\approved\catalog `
  --policy C:\approved\policy.json --policy-sha256 INDEPENDENT_APPROVED_64_HEX `
  --output C:\pgextwin-downloads
# For all 70 original ZIPs: use --pg all instead of --pg 18.
```

**Requirements:** an intact locally saved Catalog v2 with all 14 extensions, a separately approved P1 policy file and its genuine independently authenticated SHA256, network access to the existing official GitHub Releases, and a pre-existing output parent folder. If independent pins are not available, this command **fails closed**. A checksum copied only from the Catalog itself is not an independent policy approval.

The ZIPs are original already-published upstream extension release assets, not a newly signed/attested enclosing offline distribution bundle. Download success means **INTEGRITY_ONLY**; it does NOT claim to verify original extension Sigstore signatures. There is no ZIP extraction, installation, service modification, SQL execution, publisher privilege or Authenticode signature.

## Existing features

Local `list`/`search` (text or JSON), exact pinned single-file `download`, and offline signed P1 report-claim authentication (`verify-report`). `verify-report` authenticates the report source, **not** actual original release provenance. All extension authenticity/install/publication claims remain DENY.

## Verifying the CLI binary itself

Compare `pgextwin.exe` against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The genuine GitHub SLSA provenance is for **this CLI executable** (not the downloaded extension ZIPs):

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\pgextwin.exe -Algorithm SHA256
gh attestation verify .\pgextwin.exe --repo pgextwin/catalog --signer-workflow pgextwin/catalog/.github/workflows/cli-candidate.yml --source-ref refs/heads/main --source-digest 529718ac8ff829c8a98b57d26adb1d74971588c1
```

Original EXE SHA256: `1764d2f5a54b9fa715a2bba1d068493ef1d5dcb159b895e3f24becf2dee6fdc0`.

Build chain: [protected main Windows R6 signer/independent verifier Run 39205817118](https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39205817118). The EXE is not Windows Authenticode-signed. SDK 10.0.402 and self-contained runtime 10.0.13 were pinned; SPDX 2.3 and runtime LICENSE/third-party notices are attached.

Install `--apply`, one signed master ZIP bundle, genuine extension SLSA/SPDX verification, auto elevation, PostgreSQL service changes and #75 GO B/G4/G5 are out of scope; their gates are not waived.

# pgextwin CLI v0.1.0-preview.1 — Windows x64

Early read-only preview. This release is **only the pgextwin CLI executable**, not an installer or newly signed release of PostgreSQL extensions.

## What works
- Standalone self-contained Windows x64 `pgextwin.exe` (.NET 10 runtime included).
- `--help`, `--version`, `list` and `search` across the local 14-extension Catalog v2, with `--pg 14` through `--pg 18` and `--format text|json`.
- Explicit user-authorized single-asset `download` with externally approved exact Catalog/Release/policy SHA256 pins; success is **INTEGRITY_ONLY**, not attestation/authenticity verification.
- Optional independently signed P1 report authentication is **P1_REPORT_AUTHENTICATED_ONLY**, not genuine original Release Sigstore verification.

## Get started (PowerShell)
Download `pgextwin.exe` from this Release and a trusted copy of the Catalog source (the exact main snapshot may be identified independently). Extract the Catalog with its `index.json` and `extensions` directory.

```powershell
.\pgextwin.exe --version
.\pgextwin.exe list --catalog-dir C:\path\to\catalog --pg 18
.\pgextwin.exe search cron --catalog-dir C:\path\to\catalog --format json
Get-FileHash .\pgextwin.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the SHA256 with the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`, then independently verify the GitHub Sigstore build provenance against the exact owner/repo, signer workflow and source commit:

```powershell
gh attestation verify .\pgextwin.exe --repo pgextwin/catalog --signer-workflow pgextwin/catalog/.github/workflows/cli-candidate.yml --source-ref refs/heads/main --source-digest d0056b688dc27095d2d7ffd6f8b77aff965def79
```

The provenance is a signed GitHub/Sigstore attestation of this **CLI executable's SHA256**. The EXE is **not Authenticode-signed** and Windows may display an unrecognized publisher warning. Neither SHA256SUMS nor the CLI Sigstore attestation proves the authenticity of downloaded extension ZIPs.

## Safety and non-features
- Local Catalog listing remains `LOCAL_UNAUTHENTICATED / UNVERIFIED`.
- Genuine `verify` for extension SLSA/SPDX is not implemented: fail-closed / exit 2. Do not call downloaded extensions signature-verified.
- No `install --apply`, no PostgreSQL service modifications, no bundled offline ZIP generator or autonomous elevation.
- No extension, Catalog or Website Release is implicitly created by this CLI preview.
- The project does not provide malware-free guarantees. Prefer verifying the exact GitHub signed provenance and locally scanning downloaded executables.

The R6 protected-main Windows candidate, isolated signer and independent verifier completed on run [39200819667](https://github.com/pgextwin/catalog/actions/runs/39200819667). Re-run independent checks against the actual public Release binary rather than trusting these notes alone.
